Tests that identical chat requests return cached response

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const liter_llm = @import("liter_llm");

pub fn main() !void {
    var _client = try liter_llm.create_client_from_json("{\"api_key\":\"your-api-key\",\"cache\":{\"backend\":\"memory\",\"max_entries\":256,\"ttl_seconds\":300}}");
    defer _client.free();
    const _result_json = try _client.chat("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\"}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
